content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Industrial and agricultural equipment for municipalities and farms, not recreational boats sold to consumers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"School and commercial passenger buses sold to districts and fleets, not recreational boats for individual buyers."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Roofing, insulation and industrial components sold to contractors and manufacturers, unlike consumer boats."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Construction, HVAC and industrial fluid products sold to contractors and plants, not recreational boats."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Replacement auto and truck parts sold to aftermarket retailers, not boats sold to recreational consumers."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Pool and spa equipment sold to pool builders and owners; a different product set despite leisure consumer buyers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Heating, cooling and refrigeration equipment sold through HVAC contractors and distributors, not recreational boats."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Builds recreational inboard and sterndrive powerboats sold to individual buyers through independent boat dealers, matching the target."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Roofing shingles, insulation and glass fiber sold to builders and contractors, not recreational boats."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Firearms sold to shooters and law enforcement; consumer recreational products but a different business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Turf, snow and irrigation equipment sold to landscapers and homeowners, not recreational boats."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Recreational vehicles and buses sold through dealers; shares a consumer dealer channel but builds different products."}]}
